name: Noetix N2
summary: N2 is a small, light humanoid of about 1.2-1.3 m from Beijing startup Noetix Robotics, known for continuous backflips. It is sold for education, research and entertainment at a low price and took part in the 2025 Beijing humanoid half-marathon.
highlights: Can perform continuous backflips, runs and jumps on one or two legs.
Robotics and Automation News reports the N2 drew over 2,500 orders.
Competed in the 2025 Beijing humanoid robot half-marathon.
caveats: Published specs conflict: height is given as 1.2 m or 1.3 m, weight as 20 kg or 30 kg.
TMTPost reported a 59,900 yuan price for N2, while other outlets report 39,000 yuan.
